tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the year grid. Cool paper with a slate-blue bias.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the header, every day cell at rest.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells: the brush bar track, muted day cells, input backgrounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (dates in the card, period labels, who-is-off entity) on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Day numbers of weekends, holidays and non-working dates; 4.5:1 on surface-sunk and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between months, rows and panel sections.

tokens.name: hairline-2
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and chips; the grid line between am and pm halves.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary buttons, links, today outline, active chip border, focus ring.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the active brush chip and selected rows; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Validated request marker, success toast text on bg.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a success toast; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Preview warnings text on bg (balance exceeded).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning line in the review panel; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Rejected preview, failed submit, token rejected; text on bg.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error line; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: nature-tt
tokens.usage: Télétravail (reference TT) half-day fill. on-nature reads on it.

tokens.name: nature-foff
tokens.usage: Fulll Off (FOFF) fill. on-nature reads on it.

tokens.name: nature-cp
tokens.usage: Congés payés (CP) fill. on-nature reads on it.

tokens.name: nature-cetcp
tokens.usage: CET jours CP (CETCP) fill. on-nature reads on it.

tokens.name: nature-cetfoff
tokens.usage: CET jours Fulll off (CETFOFF) fill. on-nature reads on it.

tokens.name: nature-rtt
tokens.usage: RTT fill. on-nature reads on it.

tokens.name: nature-other
tokens.usage: Every other nature (sick leave, unpaid, forfait days) fill. on-nature reads on it.

tokens.name: on-nature
tokens.usage: Day number on a painted half. White in light, ink in dark; 4.5:1 on every nature-* swatch.

tokens.name: cell-muted-fg
tokens.usage: Day number on weekends, holidays and non-working dates.

tokens.name: cell-muted-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a muted day cell.

tokens.name: cell-today
tokens.usage: The 2px outline around today.

tokens.name: cell-pending
tokens.usage: The pending dot on a painted half of a request in status New or cancel ongoing; drawn with a 1px ink-2 ring so it reads on every nature.

tokens.name: cell-selected
tokens.usage: The 1px inner ring on a painted half of the current selection (not yet submitted).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop under the token prompt.
